name: ocr-bench-judge-eval-35b
description: A dataset of judge-style evaluations produced with a 35B model for OCR outputs. It is intended to measure quality of OCR transcription and judge-model assessments of OCR output correctness and ranking. The benchmark is used to compare transcription quality and model-based judgments across OCR systems.
evaluation_method: character_error_rate (CER) and exact_match (and model-based judgement scores)
reputation: A niche evaluation dataset for OCR judgement/evaluation using a large model; limited but useful for automated OCR quality comparisons.
